verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a reconciliation transactions report delivered via webhook (bvnk:ledger:report:ready), which accounting can consume. Its claims that stablecoin payments settle to fiat show settlement exists, but nothing says how long it takes. The pack has no settlement timing from payment to available balance and no published per-rail fees; the partner markup fee is not a published fee schedule. Missing for 10: documented payment-to-available-balance timing per rail, a published fee schedule per rail, and details on statement/report formats or exports.
